author: (Mörch, 1877)

note.en: A hairy triton known here from one INBio specimen at 29 m off the Gandoca-Manzanillo refuge. Size is a rough estimate, to be checked.
note.es: Un tritón peludo conocido aquí por un espécimen del INBio a 29 m frente al refugio Gandoca-Manzanillo. El tamaño es una estimación aproximada, por verificar.

evidence: GBIF: 1 living-era museum specimen (INBio), Gandoca-Manzanillo, 2003; a second record is fossil

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records for the region box (INBio Atta collection, iNaturalist)

recWhy: Recorded: GBIF: 1 living-era museum specimen[^1], Gandoca-Manzanillo, 2003; a second record is fossil.

marks.en: Large, heavy shell with strong knobby ribs, brown and cream, with a toothed lip.
marks.es: Concha grande y pesada con costillas nudosas fuertes, parda y crema, con labio dentado.
